'''Rolion sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, it contained 752 bases, including [[Lobaq Station]], [[Chirrion Base]], and a communications station at [[Fara's Belt]].

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Rolion sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
